Third-party license text inventory

License and notice text files are copied byte-for-byte from locally cached Cargo packages and vendored sources. Identical text is stored once by SHA-256. metadata.json maps crate names, exact versions, declared licenses, source URLs and original file paths to text blobs.

Scope: available notices from FilmCraft, EffectCraft and PdfCraft source lockfiles. A lockfile is broader than the dependencies linked into one Windows executable; it can include other platforms, optional code, tests and build tools. This notice collection does not assert exact binary dependency coverage.

First-party app licenses and embedded asset licenses are also in each app license folder. No source code, cache databases, user settings or credentials are included here.
Some multi-crate upstream repositories omit license files from their published crate archives. For observed Windows build dependencies, exact license/notice texts from the commits recorded in published Cargo VCS metadata are included here. rustls-cng offers MIT or Apache-2.0 in its release README; this package uses its Apache-2.0 option and includes the Apache authority text.

Corresponding unmodified source for MPL-2.0 components (including Symphonia) is available from the exact package and version source_url in metadata.json, and from https://static.crates.io/crates/NAME/NAME-VERSION.crate using that NAME and VERSION. Retain these source availability links and license notices when redistributing.
